patterns.note: Asymmetric split-screen layout for product display, featuring a large, immersive background visual on one side and a vertical list of items on the other.
Exclusive use of a monospaced sans-serif font across all text elements, from large headings to small labels, creating a consistent, code-like aesthetic.
Monochromatic color scheme primarily using light gray backgrounds and black text, with minimal accent colors reserved for specific interactive elements or product visuals.
A dynamic, canvas-based circular graphic in the hero section displays real-time data points, which scrolls out of view to reveal a sticky navigation bar and a persistent item counter.
Project listings are presented as simple, vertically stacked text links with a small bullet point and a gray placeholder, maintaining a minimalist, content-focused presentation.

technique_notes: The hero section features a custom canvas animation that visualizes abstract data points within a circular graphic, which is designed to scroll off-screen as the user navigates down the page.
A sticky header system is implemented where a set of navigation links and a 'new items' counter appear and fix to the top of the viewport only after the initial hero content has scrolled out of view.

The site employs a consistent monospaced typeface for all text, with typographic hierarchy established solely through size and weight variations, eschewing multiple font families for a unified, technical feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold monospaced headings (~3-4x body) with consistent, smaller monospaced body and label text.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy hero, balanced spacing in content sections with generous vertical rhythm between elements.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its raw, almost terminal-like aesthetic achieved through exclusive use of a monospaced font, minimal UI, and the dynamic, data-driven canvas animation in the hero. This creates a unique blend of high-tech and understated design.
